gem_guidance.text: Although Crit gems (such as Smooth Lionseye ) have dominated the past few phases of gemming, more strength-focused gemming can begin to outscale (and in some cases already has) stacking Critical Strike Rating. I recommend using a simulator to accurately figure out which form of gem is strongest for you based on your kill times/group composition/gear, etc. If in doubt, then the versatile Inscribed Pyrestone can be useful as a compromise between the two ideologies of gemming.

Belt of One-Hundred Deaths is king no longer - a warm welcome to Onslaught Belt , our belt of choice for the rest of the game. If needed (in a full BiS setup), this is one of the slots where a Rigid Lionseye should be gemmed.
